title: Children in Rocking Chair on Porch, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot from around the 1950s showing a toddler sitting in a wooden rocking chair on a porch, holding an infant dressed in a bonnet and baby gown. Potted plants and a watering can decorate the background on the porch floor, capturing a gentle moment of mid-century domestic family life. The photograph features characteristic scalloped or deckled borders.
